posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked:
Last time, FedEx sent out tracking information because I gave them everyone's email address when they printed the labels. This time I did the same thing, but they didn't send out tracking info for some reason. That has been corrected for the Convention / Website preorder people, who *should* be getting tracking numbers, and for the international kickstarter backers, but unfortunately, our domestic kickstarter backers are sans-tracking number, which makes us sad. I will impress upon FedEx the importance of such tracking numbers in the future.

Now, fortunately, domestic backers are going to be getting their orders the fastest of anyone, so you shouldn't have to wait too long. In fact, looking on the FedEx website, they will give you a handy map of Ground ship times if you input your origin zip code (which in this case is 63132). It looks like those of you on the west coast should be getting most of your shipments on Friday:

http://www.fedex.com/grd/maps/ShowMapEntry.do

Hope that helps!
